scope: ZIP archive members; original archive bytes are preserved and no member PDFs are extracted to disk.
limitations: All 648 members were read; native IPC-2581 XML parsed and Altium key/value text read.
All PDF pages were text-extracted; no OCR or graph digitization was performed.
Low text status is a density heuristic and does not establish completeness or semantic correctness.
PDF pages and member counts include repeated archive contents.
Four targeted PDF pages and seven AISLER diagrams were visually inspected separately; this is not visual review of every PDF page.
